data.name: Dillip
data.gender_notes: Dillip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dillip is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhi' meaning 'intelligence' and 'lip' meaning 'shining' or 'brilliant'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to be intelligent and bright, just like the sun. The name Dillip carries the meaning “Shining, Brilliant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dillip usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, brilliant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes intelligence and brilliance, reflecting the inner light of the soul.
data.etymology: Dillip belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining, Brilliant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dillip total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: The great king Dillip was the ruler of the Haihayas, a powerful Hindu kingdom based in Mathura (present day Uttar Pradesh, India) from 575 CE to 606 CE. He is known for his military conquests and the construction of several temples during his reign.

historical_references.reference: Dillip was also a name of a celebrated poet-saint of the Bhakti movement in medieval India. He is considered an incarnation of Lord Krishna and is believed to have lived during the 16th century. His works include 'Rasikapriya' and 'Smarana Lahari', which are revered texts in the Vaishnava tradition.
